title: Talanoa Hufanga could be out 2-3 weeks with ankle injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Talanoa Hufanga could be out 2-3 weeks with ankle injury
sources.description: Huge loss to an already injury-riddled Denver Broncos secondary. Safety Talanoa Hufanga is reportedly looking at a 2-3 game absence with an ankle injury.
